data.exact_reserve_text: The significant movements in net claims incurred in respect of claims provisions created at the end of the previous period are analysed as follows:

prior_year_events.event_name: Difficult legal environment in the Irish Republic
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse results emanating from the Irish Republic due to the difficult legal environment required corrective action and impacted prior periods' results and reserves

data.standardized_narrative: Prior-year reserves strengthened materially (approximately GBP 23.2m gross) driven by adverse development on pre-2015 underwriting years (notably 2013 and 2014). The managing agent attributes the movement to adverse claims development including difficult legal environment issues in the Irish Republic, higher-than-expected early losses on a small premium base, recalibration of IBNR and movements in reinsurance recoveries; RITC and FX exposures also influenced reported balances.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse results emanating from the Irish Republic due to the difficult legal environment
impact of a number of early losses had a disproportionate impact on a small premium base
foreign exchange losses of GBP 3.3m arising from the syndicate's exposure to the Euro
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle because no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was provided. The triangle may be influenced by reinsurance-to-close (RITC) activity and therefore the PYD figure carries some model/interpretation risk. Some LOB movement figures in the report are only provided on a net basis; where gross per-LOB prior-year movements were not available, net figures were used for LOB-level directional indication and flagged with reduced confidence.
